name: Uzma Berhad
overview: 2026年，Uzma Berhad 的 New Energy 板块通过子公司 Uzma Environergy 与 MIMOS、Universiti Tenaga Nasional、NanoMalaysia 等机构签署多项谅解备忘录，涉及能源管理、储能和可再生能源研发合作；Others 板块通过 Geospatial AI 与 Infrasel 合作开展卫星地理空间斜坡监测，并通过新设子公司 Uzma Space and Defence 与 Boustead Holdings 及 MARA 签署谅解备忘录，探索卫星通信、地理空间情报及航空航天与国防维修、可再生能源等领域的合作。
overview_en: In 2026, Uzma Berhad's New Energy segment, through subsidiary Uzma Environergy, signed multiple memoranda of understanding with MIMOS, Universiti Tenaga Nasional, and NanoMalaysia for collaboration in energy management, storage, and renewable energy R&D;

segments.name: 新能源
segments.note: 子公司 Uzma Environergy 与多家机构签署谅解备忘录，在能源管理、储能和可再生能源领域开展研发与合作。
segments.note_en: Subsidiary Uzma Environergy signed MOUs with several institutions for R&D and collaboration in energy management, storage, and renewable energy.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Uzma Environergy 与 MIMOS Services、Universiti Tenaga Nasional 及 NanoMalaysia 的谅解备忘录状态无变化，涉及 ICT 与微电子研发、能源管理与储能及可再生能源联合开发、可再生能源研究资助与知识交流。
actions.text_en: Status of Uzma Environergy's MOUs with MIMOS Services, Universiti Tenaga Nasional, and NanoMalaysia remained unchanged, covering ICT and microelectronics R&D, joint development of energy management and storage and renewable energy solutions, and renewable ener…

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Uzma Environergy 与 MIMOS Services、Universiti Tenaga Nasional 及 NanoMalaysia 的谅解备忘录状态无变化。
actions.text_en: Status of Uzma Environergy's MOUs with MIMOS Services, Universiti Tenaga Nasional, and NanoMalaysia remained unchanged.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Majlis Amanah Rakyat (MARA) 签署谅解备忘录，探索在可再生能源与能源效率、航空航天与国防 MRO、技术及土著人才与供应商发展方面的战略合作。
actions.text_en: Signed an MOU with Majlis Amanah Rakyat (MARA) to explore strategic collaboration in renewable energy and energy efficiency, aerospace and defence MRO, technology, and Bumiputera talent and vendor development.

actions.text_en: Status of Uzma Environergy's MOUs with MIMOS Services, Universiti Tenaga Nasional, and NanoMalaysia remained unchanged.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Geospatial AI 与 Infrasel 的谅解备忘录状态无变化，涉及使用卫星地理空间技术在 Selangor 进行斜坡监测与基础设施风险管理。
actions.text_en: Status of Geospatial AI's MOU with Infrasel remained unchanged, covering slope monitoring and infrastructure risk management in Selangor using satellite-based geospatial technologies.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: Geospatial AI 与 Infrasel 的谅解备忘录状态无变化。
actions.text_en: Status of Geospatial AI's MOU with Infrasel remained unchanged.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 全资子公司 Uzma Space and Defence 与 Boustead Holdings 签署谅解备忘录，探索在卫星通信 (SATCOM) 和地理空间情报 (GEOINT) 领域的战略合作，支持国防、安全及相关国家应用。
actions.text_en: Wholly owned subsidiary Uzma Space and Defence signed an MOU with Boustead Holdings to explore strategic collaboration in satellite communications (SATCOM) and geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) in support of defence, security, and related national applications.

model_changes.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
model_changes.text: 通过全资子公司 Uzma Space and Defence 与 Boustead Holdings 签署谅解备忘录，探索卫星通信和地理空间情报业务，涉及国防与安全领域。
model_changes.text_en: Through wholly owned subsidiary Uzma Space and Defence, signed an MOU with Boustead Holdings to explore satellite communications and geospatial intelligence business in the defence and security sector.
